title: Computing the convex envelope of bivariate piecewise linear-quadratic functions in linear time
summary: We compute the convex envelope of (nonconvex) bivariate piecewise linear-quadratic (PLQ) functions (bivariate quadratic functions defined on a polyhedral subdivision).
